scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && node scripts/generate-notices.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.desktop:package:zip: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src server/src desktop scripts tests *.json *.md *.ts *.cjs .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client/src server/src desktop scripts tests *.json *.md *.ts *.cjs .github
